suite.label: Benchmark
suite.tip: A set of tasks the agent is tested on.

task.label: Task
task.tip: One job the agent must do, checked automatically.

admitted.label: Ready
admitted.tip: Heimdall checked the task is fair: a correct solution passes and an agent that does nothing fails.

admission.label: Readiness check
admission.tip: Heimdall checks each task is fair: a correct solution passes and an agent that does nothing fails.

draft.label: Not ready
draft.tip: Failed the readiness check, so it is not used in tests.

locked.label: Frozen
locked.tip: The tasks are pinned so every run sees exactly the same version.

probe.label: Failure test
probe.tip: A harder version of the tasks: a model outage, a trick instruction, a fake secret.

tier.label: Difficulty level
tier.tip: How hard the tasks are. Higher levels add failure tests on top of the normal tasks.

experiment.label: Comparison
experiment.tip: Runs two setups (A and B) on the same tasks and tells you which is better.

armA.label: Setup A (baseline)
armA.tip: The setup you have today. Setup B is compared against it.

armB.label: Setup B (candidate)
armB.tip: The new setup you want to try. It is compared against Setup A.

verdict.label: Result
verdict.tip: What the comparison concluded: B is better, B is worse, no clear winner yet, or the test was broken.

inconclusive.label: No clear winner yet
inconclusive.tip: Not enough evidence; run more tasks.

invalid.label: Test was broken
invalid.tip: Something went wrong while measuring (not the agent's fault). Fix and re-check.

score.label: Scored
score.tip: One setup scored on its own, with a 95% range. Nothing was compared, so there is no better or worse.

improved.label: B is better
improved.tip: Setup B solved more tasks than Setup A, and the difference is clear.

regressed.label: B is worse
regressed.tip: Setup B solved fewer tasks than Setup A, and the difference is clear.

run.label: Run
run.tip: One attempt by one agent at one task.

sealed.label: Saved and locked
sealed.tip: The results are stored with a signature, so any later change would be detected.

manifest.label: Test recipe (signature)
manifest.tip: The exact settings of this comparison, signed.

grades.label: Scores / Re-score
grades.tip: Scores are the grader's marks for each run. Re-score grades the same saved work again.

gate.label: Safety check
gate.tip: A rule that fails a run that cheated or did something unsafe.

guard.label: Safety rule
guard.tip: A rule that watches what the agent does and stops or flags unsafe actions.

integrityViolation.label: Cheating or unsafe action detected
integrityViolation.tip: The agent tried to cheat (for example, reading the hidden checks) or did something unsafe. The run fails.

abortedInfra.label: Infrastructure error (not counted)
abortedInfra.tip: The run broke before the agent could work; it is retried.

verifier.label: Grader / hidden checks
verifier.tip: Tests the agent never sees that decide if it solved the task.

flakyVerifier.label: Unreliable grader
flakyVerifier.tip: The grader gave different answers for the same work.

meters.label: Measurements
meters.tip: Numbers recorded for each run, such as cost, time, steps and tokens.

diagnostics.label: Details by failure test
diagnostics.tip: The same results split into the normal run and each failure test.

conditionClean.label: Normal run
conditionClean.tip: The tasks as written, with no failure test added.

stats.label: Statistics (advanced)
stats.tip: How sure we are that the difference between A and B is real, and the smallest difference this test can detect.

canary.label: Drift monitor
canary.tip: A small test re-run on a schedule to catch an agent or model silently getting worse.

inbox.label: Failure inbox
inbox.tip: Failures collected from real use, waiting to be turned into new tasks.

traceSource.label: Where failures come from
traceSource.tip: A system that sends failed agent sessions into the failure inbox.

livescore.label: Live quality scoring
livescore.tip: Scores real agent sessions as they happen, so you see quality in production.

runner.label: Worker / shared worker
runner.tip: A machine that actually runs the agents.

lease.label: Claim on a worker
lease.tip: Internal bookkeeping for which worker runs which task. You can usually ignore it.

policy.label: Release rule
policy.tip: A rule a new agent version must pass before it can be released.

release.label: Release record
release.tip: A saved record that an agent version shipped, with the evidence behind it.

calibration.label: Grader accuracy check
calibration.tip: Compares the grader's marks with human marks to see how often it is right.

synthetic.label: Practice mode (no real model, free)
synthetic.tip: Runs with a scripted stand-in model instead of a real one. Free, good for trying things, not real results.

oracle.label: Perfect reference agent
oracle.tip: An agent that applies the known correct solution. Used to check that a task can be solved.

noop.label: Do-nothing agent
noop.tip: An agent that does nothing. Used to check that a task cannot be passed for free.

capabilities.label: Skills tested
capabilities.tip: The kinds of ability a benchmark checks, such as coding, browsing or tool use.

license.label: License
license.tip: The terms under which the tasks may be used and shared.
